UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Tracks a Sanatani explorer's spiritual progress, unlocked temple lore, and completed rituals.

diyasLit.description: Total sacred oil lamps lit across expeditions.

highestSurvivalSec.description: Longest survival duration in a cursed sanctum in seconds.

unlockedCodexIds.description: Bounded list of unlocked mythological creature and temple lore IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of profile creation via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ExpeditionRoom.title: ExpeditionRoom
ExpeditionRoom.description: Online multiplayer co-op horror expedition room in a cursed ancient temple.

templeId.description: Identifier of the temple (brihadeeswarar, konark, kailasa).

entityName.description: Name of the mythological guardian/entity haunting the temple.

diyasLitCount.description: Shared number of sacred Diyas lit in the sanctum (0 to 5).

sealsUnlocked.description: Shared number of ancient Vedic seals unlocked (0 to 3).

entityX.description: Current X coordinate of the hunting mythological creature.

entityY.description: Current Y coordinate of the hunting mythological creature.

entityAlertLevel.description: Aggression / chase alert level of the creature (0 to 100).

lastRitualEvent.description: Latest shared co-op event message (e.g., bell rung, mantra chanted, seal solved).

memberUids.description: Bounded list of up to 4 participating player UIDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest state sync via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PlayerPresence.title: PlayerPresence
PlayerPresence.description: Real-time position, torch state, and prana vitality of a player inside an ExpeditionRoom.

roomCode.description: 6-character code of the room this presence belongs to.

x.description: Player X coordinate in temple grid.

y.description: Player Y coordinate in temple grid.

diyaLit.description: Whether the player's brass Diya lamp is currently burning.

chantingMantra.description: Whether the player is actively chanting a protective Vedic mantra.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of presence update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Stores personal progress, statistics, and unlocked codex entries for each authenticated user.

/expedition_rooms/{roomId}.description: Stores active and joinable multiplayer temple horror co-op rooms.

/expedition_rooms/{roomId}/players/{play.description: Stores real-time telemetry and ritual states for each player in an expedition room.
